routeContracts.notes: Health check is intentionally unauthenticated and must not touch Google paid services.
Static package metadata; no Firestore/Payment calls allowed.
Admin-only Vertex/Gemini surface. Requires feature toggle, model allowlist, bounded inputs/outputs, cost estimate, and telemetry/debug evidence.
Admin-only AI assistant. Must stay behind admin auth, trusted origin, and adaptive budget guard.
Admin GA/Data API surface. Must prefer snapshot/hot-cache layers, return quota where supported, and emit quota/debug evidence.
Admin support inbox reads/replies across nested support messages and must preserve admin auth and user privacy.
Admin content/storage surface. Storage calls must stay admin-only, MEDIA_PROXY rate limited, and expose short-lived admin preview URLs only.

Admin creator agreement document surface. Storage calls must stay admin-only, MEDIA_PROXY rate limited, path-scoped to creator-agreements/, and expose metadata or short-lived signed document previews only.
Admin creator ID document preview surface. Storage calls must stay admin-only, MEDIA_PROXY rate limited, path-scoped to creator-onboarding/{userId}/id/{side}/, and never expose raw Storage URLs.
Default admin API contract. Mutations require trusted origin; heavy reads should be bounded or cached.
Telemetry ingest must preserve consent/session enrichment and avoid unbounded write fanout.
Auth helper endpoints may be public but must stay trusted-origin and rate limited.
Chat attachment preparation/completion touches Storage and must stay user-scoped, rate limited, and bounded.
Chat can debit paid-source GumDrops. Keep business logic server-authoritative and rate limited.
Daily check-in writes reward-source balance and must remain idempotent and rate limited.
Public creator discovery must be bounded and should prefer cache/server seeding.
Creator asset upload/download surface; must stay creator/user-scoped and rate limited.
Creator agreement document preview is authenticated, creator-scoped, MEDIA_PROXY rate limited, path-scoped to creator-agreements/, and exposes only short-lived signed document URLs.
Creator booking spend uses paid-source balance only.
Creator request spend uses paid-source balance only.
Creator subscriptions use paid-source balance and deterministic idempotency.
Creator private messages may spend paid-source GumDrops.
Default creator API contract; creator state changes must be user-scoped, trusted-origin, and rate limited.
Public creator profile data must be sanitized and bounded.
Cron endpoints are explicitly exempt from trusted-origin because they use cron secret/request verification. Batches must stay bounded.
Client debug evidence ingest must be same-origin, redacted, and non-blocking.
Unlocked media proxy must enforce entitlement, range-aware rate limiting, no-store cache, and raw URL hiding.
Drop unlock spends GumDrops in a Firestore transaction and must preserve idempotency.
Public Drops feed uses SWR + ETag and bounded pagination.
Default Drops interaction contract. Writes must be trusted-origin and bounded; normal unlock/payment surfaces have stricter contracts.
Notification inbox read/action state must stay user-scoped and rate limited.
PayPal routes are payment-sensitive and require trusted origin, authenticated caller, locks, and idempotent ledger writes.
Privacy consent writes are allowed but must keep consent and telemetry truth intact.
Security attempt logging must stay bounded and same-origin.
Admin landing asset upload must stay admin-only and bounded.
Public landing settings are low-cost reads and should stay cached/bounded.
Support routes must keep users scoped to their own threads and nested messages; guest entry stays same-origin and bounded.
Tasks/reminders/feedback writes must stay user-scoped and bounded.
Public username availability lookup must stay rate limited and bounded.
User profile/activity routes must stay caller-scoped, trusted-origin for mutations, and rate limited.
Viewer watch telemetry writes must stay bounded and must not reveal locked content.
